delete.confirmBody: We'll keep your data for 30 days in case you change your mind. After that, everything is permanently removed. This action cannot be undone after the grace period ends.
delete.graceBannerBody: Your account will be permanently deleted on {date}. You can cancel this at any time before then.
delete.emailConfirmSubject: Your markoto account is scheduled for deletion
delete.emailExecutedSubject: Your markoto account has been deleted

consequences.title: Here's exactly what will happen
consequences.intro: We want you to see the full picture before you confirm. Everything below runs automatically once the 30-day grace window ends.

deleted.heading: Permanently deleted
deleted.ownedDocs: {count} document(s) you own — including any you've shared with collaborators in edit mode. Co-collaborators lose access at the same time.
deleted.themes: Your saved themes and personal preferences.
deleted.ai: Your AI sessions, prompt history, and usage counters.
deleted.exports: {count} previous data export(s) and their downloadable ZIP files.
deleted.stripe: Your Stripe customer record (Stripe retains underlying invoices for the period required by tax law).

anonymised.heading: Kept on the platform with your name removed
anonymised.comments: {count} comment(s) you wrote on documents you don't own — replaced with "[deleted user]". The bodies stay so other participants can still follow the conversation.
anonymised.activity: {count} activity-log entry on documents you don't own — shown as "Anonymous" going forward.
anonymised.audit: {count} entry in our internal security log — your user id is removed.
anonymised.consent: {count} consent decision(s) — anonymised but retained as legal proof under GDPR Article 7(1).

cascadeDelete.title: Will be cascade-deleted (sole member)
cascadeDelete.body: These workspaces will be permanently removed along with every document and knowledge file inside. If you want to preserve their contents, invite a co-member with admin role first, then come back and request deletion.

promote.title: Will get a new admin (other members exist)
promote.body: These workspaces stay live for the remaining members. The longest-tenured member becomes admin.

removeMember.title: You'll just be removed
removeMember.body: Workspaces where you're an editor or viewer continue without you.

manualSteps.heading: Steps you may want to take first
manualSteps.exportFirst: Use the data export feature to download everything we hold about you as a ZIP — keep that file regardless of what happens here.
manualSteps.transferDocs: For any document you want a collaborator to keep, either move it to a workspace they own or have them duplicate it.
manualSteps.inviteWorkspaceMember: For any workspace you want to preserve, invite at least one admin-role collaborator before deleting.
manualSteps.downloadKnowledge: For knowledge-base files you want preserved, download them outside markoto first.

consequences.timing: The actual cascade runs as a background job once per hour. After the grace window ends, your data is fully purged within about an hour.
consequences.noRecovery: Once the cascade runs, your account and content are gone permanently — there is no recovery path.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: Your account, the data we hold about you, and the controls for managing both. Spending and usage details will live here too as those features ship.

spending.heading: Spending and usage
spending.comingSoon: Coming soon — your AI credit usage, plan history, and invoices will live here. For now, manage billing from the Pricing page.

data.heading: Your data
data.exportTitle: Download a copy of your data
data.exportDescription: We'll prepare a ZIP with everything we hold about you — your account profile, every document you own as Markdown, comments you've authored, billing history, AI usage logs, audit and consent records. The build runs in the background, usually under a minute. This page refreshes when it's ready, and we'll also email you a download link. The link is valid for 7 days.
data.exportInProgress: Export in progress — this page refreshes when it's ready.

delete.heading: Delete your account
delete.description: We'll keep your data for 30 days in case you change your mind. After that, everything is permanently removed — documents, comments, workspace memberships, billing history. Workspaces where you're the only member are cascade-deleted; workspaces with co-members get a new admin automatically.

legal.heading: Legal
legal.subheading: Versions of the Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Data Processing Addendum you have accepted. If we update any document materially, you'll see "needs re-acceptance" here and we re-prompt before any further action.

consent.heading: Privacy choices
consent.subheading: What we may track about your use of markoto. Essential storage is always on (login + your consent decision itself). The other two surfaces are off until you grant them — change your mind here at any time.

aiProvider.title: AI provider
aiProvider.intro: Bring your own key: connect your own OpenAI-compatible AI provider for each feature. Your provider account pays for these calls. markoto stores the key encrypted and never shows it again.
aiProvider.privacyNote: For these features, your prompts, the relevant document context and your recordings are sent to the provider you choose, under your own agreement with that provider.
aiProvider.platformNote: Knowledge-base search, web search and page fetching always run on markoto's own providers.
aiProvider.privateAllowedNote: This instance also accepts providers on your private network, such as Ollama.
aiProvider.pointsOwnKeyHint: Calls made with your own provider key are billed by your provider and don't use AI Points.

chat.title: Writing assistant
chat.description: Required for every AI feature: the prompt bar, {'@'}ai in comments and web-search summaries. The model must support tool calling.
